_comment: AMGX for the rhoSimpleFoam pressure equation. TWO choices here are not the wrapper's defaults,
and both were forced by measurement (2026-09-13):
solver FGMRES, not PCG. The tutorials run `transonic yes`, which makes the pressure matrix
ASYMMETRIC. The amgxFoam wrapper's built-in config is PCG, a symmetric solver, and it diverges
to a negative temperature on squareBend.
algorithm CLASSICAL, not AGGREGATION. With aggregation this matrix takes 414 iterations to
reach only 0.62 relative residual. With classical it takes 2-4. NOTE: AMGX 2.5.0's classical
path throws a Thrust error on sm_121 (GB10) -- see amgxSolver.C -- so this config is usable on
sm_90 (GH200) and not on GB10. That is why the AMGX arm was empty until a Hopper box appeared.
